scientific_fronts.requirement: Exact identities, admitted aliases, carriers/bases, source conflicts and separation of target from build
Peak amount is not sensory importance; unknown constituents and unknown odor events retained
Matrix/geometry/time-specific mass conservation; no missing-property defaults
Compatible OAV diagnostic; admitted exact gas curves; corrected threshold equation; separate mixture challengers
Simple profile baseline first; endpoint/coverage limits and human labels
Independent human labels, individual variability, blinded protocol and explicit ties
Separate blinded sensory result from branded consumer concept/market response
Leakage-safe splits, equal-budget random/local/adaptive arms, Pareto endpoints and selected-outcome metrics
Exact product/matrix behavior and measured homogeneity; no universal shelf-life/solubility claim
Independent current reviewed policy, exact limits/aliases and finished-product assessment; never creative beauty authority
Time/region/channel/franchise scope; no sales-derived liking label
Hydroalcoholic EDP/EDT, oil, solid, mist, hair/textile and functional matrices are not interchangeable
Exact fingerprints, explicit source/review states, no runtime web calls and focused tests
µL liquids/mg solids, proper stock arithmetic, additive-only deltas, no duplicate transfer and proportionate questions

market_segments.requirement: Region/channel/price-period evidence required; not inferred from a scent family
Define relative to the selected market, not a universal price threshold
Can be mainstream while belonging to a prestige retail segment
Exact collection/product rather than a brand-wide assumption
Not proof of unusual quality or low mass appeal
Do not infer proprietary composition, equivalence or licensing from marketing
